title: I Turned LaPeace into a Chess.com Bot
summary: Meme variant vs a custom 'LaPeace/Lapis Bot' on a chess.com-style board: each side has an immovable 'piece of Lapis' (blue gem token) placed on a random empty square in its own half of the board. If your Lapis is captured you lose (checkmate also still works). Game 1 the narrator gets tunnel vision and loses his Lapis; game 2 (White) he wins by Nc3-a4xb6 capturing the bot's Lapis; game 3 he also wins with Black by capturing the Lapis on b3.
rules: Standard chess start and rules (checkmate still wins).
Each side gets one Lapis token on a random empty square in its own half (ranks 3-4 for White, 5-6 for Black; e.g. White h3 / Black e6, later Black b6, White's... b3 for bot).
Lapis cannot move; it can be captured like a piece by any enemy piece moving onto its square.
If your Lapis is captured you lose immediately; capturing the enemy Lapis wins.
Checks must still be answered normally.
win_condition: Capture the bot's Lapis token or checkmate it.
